answer: A graph auditor maps each identity's funding wallet, device fingerprint, and payout address in an ivory ledger, and any cluster sharing two of the three links collapses to one earning seat. The trigger is the link itself: a shared wallet or fingerprint costs the whole cluster its pending rewards and its seats. Forging 1,000 fakes means funding 1,000 separate wallets at $25 each, $25,000 in deposits, while one honest agent funds the single wallet it already uses. Like a haven cut into shale, the network stays open but holds only one copy of each traveler.
